headline: Your money, your terms — no fine print surprises
subheading: A term account built around you, not the bank.
body_paragraphs: You work hard for your money. So when you put it aside for a fixed term, you should know exactly what you're getting — and exactly what you're giving up.
With our term account, you choose how long you lock in. You see the rate up front. You decide what happens when the term ends. No branch visit, no paperwork chase, no waiting on hold.
Open it in minutes from your phone. Track it in the same app you already use. Move money in when it suits you, and let it sit until you're ready.
You get a clear rate, a clear end date, and a clear next step. That's it.
